{
  "evidence": [
    {
      "quote": "1 For this circular, UCITS funds means (i) Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) domiciled in France, Luxembourg, Ireland and the Netherlands, and (ii) collective investment schemes domiciled in the United Kingdom authorised as UK UCITS.",
      "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"
    },
    {
      "quote": "(ii)       Material changes in investment objectives, policies and restrictions – Removing the SFC’s requirement on prior approval for material changes in investment objectives, policies and restrictions which comply with the fund’s home jurisdiction requirements, except for changes that involve novel or complex product features and/or which may have local policy implications.",
      "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"
    },
    {
      "quote": "The streamlined measures set out in the relevant FAQs will take effect on 28 November 2025 (Effective Date).",
      "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u9.1696"
    },
    {
      "quote": "Existing applications received by the SFC before the Effective Date for which no approval or authorisation has been granted will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.",
      "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"
    },
    {
      "quote": "The SFC will continue to conduct post-vetting of scheme changes (including those not subject to the SFC’s prior approval) and related revised documents filed with the SFC.",
      "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u12.2069"
    }
  ],
  "frame_assumptions": [
    "Both frames assess the same identified change to the same fund, including every objective, policy or restriction component and every product feature involved in that change.",
    "The SFC, proposing management company and home regulator named in each frame are the same respective actors; identity is a premise, not established by this proposal.",
    "Both frames use the same assessment date and the same application covering the change. Pending status is fixed by SFC receipt and absence of approval or authorisation at 28 November 2025.",
    "The two European-UCITS classifications and the two UK-UCITS classifications coincide only if the fund's domicile and authorisation facts satisfy the quoted circular definition.",
    "Satisfaction of home requirements and whether requirements are met refer to the same complete set of applicable home-jurisdiction requirements for this change.",
    "The specific effective date governs the circular's general immediate-effect wording. The transition is interpreted to preserve the existing process for a qualifying pending application.",
    "Neither frame treats post-vetting as prior approval, or failure of removal eligibility as proof of an independent approval obligation."
  ],
  "left_frame": {
    "actors": [
      "SFC, which receives applications and administers prior approval and post-vetting.",
      "Fund management company proposing the investment change.",
      "Fund’s home regulator, whose jurisdiction supplies the applicable home requirements."
    ],
    "objects": [
      "SFC-authorised fund and its domicile and UCITS classification.",
      "Proposed material investment change, with objective, policy and restriction components identified separately.",
      "Product features implicated by that change.",
      "Applicable home-jurisdiction requirements.",
      "Possible Hong Kong policy implications of the change.",
      "Related SFC application, its receipt date and its approval or authorisation status at transition.",
      "Revised scheme documents subject to filing and post-vetting."
    ],
    "temporal_basis": "Assess reliance on or after 28 November 2025, while separately fixing related application receipt and approval or authorisation status at the effective-date transition.",
    "unit_of_assessment": "One identified material post-authorisation investment change for one fund, including its implicated product features and related application history."
  },
  "left_schema_hash": "de1f95c28531c3c20d81e6ab70aa8a0328f73e38f47b573b6db7fd21c4277bc1",
  "mapping": {
    "assumptions": [
      "The expressions use Boolean operators and integer equality. For either flag integer, bit 0 is true exactly when the integer is odd; bit 1 is true exactly when the integer is 2 or 3.",
      "fund_class_flags and change_scope_flags each have values only in 0, 1, 2 or 3. The European and UK classifications are separately recoverable; their mutual exclusivity follows only if the fund-specific domicile and authorisation premises are established.",
      "The assessment date is a Gregorian calendar date, with the same value in both frames.",
      "The home-requirement, feature, local-policy and application-history facts concern the identified change, not an unrelated feature or application.",
      "For either model, true means eligibility for the stated removal within its scope. TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT labels that narrow true outcome only; it does not assert general legal compliance, approval or exemption from post-vetting.",
      "The quoted circular and this model proposal do not establish the factual premises, the referenced FAQs' full requirements, or legal equivalence of the two formalizations."
    ],
    "common_facts": [
      {
        "meaning": "Integer flags for the assessed fund: bit 0 means it is a UCITS domiciled in France, Luxembourg, Ireland or the Netherlands; bit 1 means it is a United Kingdom-domiciled collective investment scheme authorised as UK UCITS. Value is restricted to 0 through 3.",
        "name": "fund_class_flags",
        "requires_judgment": true,
        "source_unit_ids": ["d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"],
        "type": "integer",
        "unit": "two separately interpretable Boolean classification flags for one fund"
      },
      {
        "meaning": "Integer flags for the same identified change: bit 0 means it is a post-authorisation matter for an SFC-authorised fund; bit 1 means it materially changes at least one fund investment objective, policy or restriction. Value is restricted to 0 through 3.",
        "name": "change_scope_flags",
        "requires_judgment": true,
        "source_unit_ids": ["d97b56331f41a.u3.575", "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"],
        "type": "integer",
        "unit": "two separately interpretable Boolean scope flags for one change"
      },
      {
        "meaning": "Gregorian calendar date for assessing reliance on the removal measure for the identified change.",
        "name": "assessment_date",
        "requires_judgment": false,
        "source_unit_ids": ["d97b56331f41a.u9.1696"],
        "type": "date",
        "unit": "Gregorian calendar date"
      },
      {
        "meaning": "The identified change satisfies every applicable requirement of the fund's home jurisdiction.",
        "name": "home_requirements",
        "requires_judgment": true,
        "source_unit_ids": ["d97b56331f41a.u5.840"],
        "type": "bool",
        "unit": "truth value across requirements applicable to the identified change"
      },
      {
        "meaning": "At least one product feature involved in the identified change is novel.",
        "name": "novel_feature",
        "requires_judgment": true,
        "source_unit_ids": ["d97b56331f41a.u5.840"],
        "type": "bool",
        "unit": "truth value across product features involved in the identified change"
      },
      {
        "meaning": "At least one product feature involved in the identified change is complex.",
        "name": "complex_feature",
        "requires_judgment": true,
        "source_unit_ids": ["d97b56331f41a.u5.840"],
        "type": "bool",
        "unit": "truth value across product features involved in the identified change"
      },
      {
        "meaning": "The identified change may have local policy implications; realised implications are not required.",
        "name": "possible_local_policy_implications",
        "requires_judgment": true,
        "source_unit_ids": ["d97b56331f41a.u5.840"],
        "type": "bool",
        "unit": "truth value for the identified change"
      },
      {
        "meaning": "An application covering the identified change was received by the SFC before 28 November 2025 and had received neither approval nor authorisation at that date. False includes no such application.",
        "name": "pending_application_at_transition",
        "requires_judgment": true,
        "source_unit_ids": ["d97b56331f41a.u9.1696", "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"],
        "type": "bool",
        "unit": "truth value over applications covering the identified change at the transition"
      }
    ],
    "evidence": [
      {
        "quote": "1 For this circular, UCITS funds means (i) Undertakings for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS) domiciled in France, Luxembourg, Ireland and the Netherlands, and (ii) collective investment schemes domiciled in the United Kingdom authorised as UK UCITS.",
        "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u17.2556"
      },
      {
        "quote": "(ii)       Material changes in investment objectives, policies and restrictions – Removing the SFC’s requirement on prior approval for material changes in investment objectives, policies and restrictions which comply with the fund’s home jurisdiction requirements, except for changes that involve novel or complex product features and/or which may have local policy implications.",
        "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u5.840"
      },
      {
        "quote": "The streamlined measures set out in the relevant FAQs will take effect on 28 November 2025 (Effective Date).",
        "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u9.1696"
      },
      {
        "quote": "Existing applications received by the SFC before the Effective Date for which no approval or authorisation has been granted will be processed by the SFC in accordance with the existing approval or authorisation process.",
        "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u10.1809"
      },
      {
        "quote": "The SFC will continue to conduct post-vetting of scheme changes (including those not subject to the SFC’s prior approval) and related revised documents filed with the SFC.",
        "unit_id": "d97b56331f41a.u12.2069"
      }
    ],
    "left": {
      "assessment_date": "assessment_date",
      "covered_eu_ucits": "(or (= fund_class_flags 1) (= fund_class_flags 3))",
